Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our InfoSec team needs a handful of artifacts to close out the SIG/SOC2 intake for Redwood. Can you provide the following sample artifacts by EOD Thu (Aug 27)?

- A set of SAML assertion examples (both successful and denied flows) covering SP-initiated and IdP-initiated logins.
- SCIM delta export for the last 3 weeks (schema and a sample of updates / deletes).
- RBAC role entitlement matrix and a small activation sample showing which users recently gained elevated roles.
- Telemetry export of role_activation events (timestamp, session_id, actor_id, target_role, source) for a 30-day window — we will require pseudonymized IDs (no direct PII).

Please also indicate whether session IDs and user identifiers can be pseudonymized and what redaction steps you propose. We need these artifacts to validate least-privilege controls.

If possible deliver via our secure SFTP (sftp.horizonhealth.com dropbox/hzn-redwood) or share a restricted Drive link. Our auditor (SOC team) will want to review samples — I can introduce them once we have a package.

Thanks,

We can provide the artefacts you listed. Quick clarifying questions so we scope exactly what to hand off:

1) Sampling window for SCIM and telemetry: you asked for 30 days for role_activation telemetry; do you want the same 30-day window for SCIM deltas, or should we send the last 21 days to match your earlier note?

3) RBAC activation sample: do you want a time-series of activation events (ndjson) or a small CSV join-ready sample?

I attached a starter pack so you can review formats — this is safe to share (no production PII):
- entitlement_matrix_sample.csv (RBAC mapping, canned sample)
- saml_assertions_samples.txt (redacted assertion captures)

Jonas — can you prepare the scim_delta export and a telemetry runbook that includes the redaction steps (we'll run it in staging then prod export)?

We can push everything to the SFTP you listed or create a restricted Drive folder and share an expiring link. Target delivery: Wed Aug 26 (staging exports) and final redacted bundle Thu Aug 27 morning.

Adding a bit more technical detail on the telemetry and SCIM exports.

- Telemetry export: our event store produces ndjson by default. We'll extract events where event_type == "role_activation" between 2026-07-24T00:00:00Z and 2026-08-23T23:59:59Z (30d). The file will be compressed (gz). Sample fields: timestamp (UTC), event_id, session_id, pseudonym_user_id, actor_service, target_role, request_origin, request_ip (we can mask IPs to /24 or drop entirely per your guidance).
- Pseudonymization plan: we will run a redaction pipeline that replaces user.email and user.name with a stable hash: H = HMAC_SHA256(salt_v1, user_id). We will provide the hash algorithm and a short integrity proof (no salts).
- SCIM delta: we'll export partner-scoped provisioning events (create/update/delete) for the 21-day window you mentioned if you confirm — default format ndjson with standard SCIM patch schema.
- RBAC activation sample: we'll provide two exports: a) small CSV join-ready sample (entitlement_matrix_sample.csv) and b) an ndjson activation sample (rbac_activation_sample.ndjson).

Attachments (stubs) included here for your review: scim_delta_20260801-20260822.ndjson (sample of 50 events), rbac_activation_sample.ndjson, telemetry_role_activation_export.gz (placeholder).

Irene, please confirm retention and redaction logs we need to attach for SOC2 evidence (audit trail showing redaction run and who executed it).

-Jonas
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
